security_controls: does not merge immediately or bypass repository rules
does not check out or execute repository code
creates no duplicate open pull requests
enables GitHub native auto-merge only after the PR exists
required_repository_configuration: Settings > Actions > General > Workflow permissions: Read and write permissions
Settings > Actions > General > Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests
Settings > General > Pull Requests > Allow auto-merge
validation_required: a non-main branch push creates exactly one open pull request to main
the same push-triggered workflow enables native GitHub auto-merge
a later push to that branch does not create a duplicate pull request
the code-owner approval and protected-branch requirements remain enforced

initial_attempt.reason: The workflow used gh pr create --fill, which requires a local Git checkout; the job intentionally does not check out repository code.
initial_attempt.remediation: Replaced --fill with explicit branch-based title and body; no checkout is required.
